> npm run build && node scripts/test-commerce.cjs && node scripts/test-payments.cjs && node scripts/test-payment-flow.cjs


> electrical-backend@0.1.0 build
> tsc -p tsconfig.json

PASS account registration hashes password and issues a scoped session
PASS duplicate accounts and invalid passwords are rejected
PASS login and protected account profile work
PASS quote ignores client prices and computes GST and shipping on server
PASS unknown inventory and GST cannot be purchased
PASS checkout persists a real order and reserves stock atomically
PASS repeated checkout is idempotent and does not double reserve
PASS tracking requires a valid private token and exact order number
PASS account order history is scoped to its authenticated owner
PASS stock shortage fails without extra orders or reservations
PASS unconfigured online payment and forged signatures are rejected
PASS guest checkout saves a separate order without claiming an account
12 commerce checks passed
3 payment verification checks passed (mock provider; no real payment).
PASS inclusive quote and enabled payment methods
PASS Razorpay order creation and stock reservation
PASS retry resumes the same order without another charge order
PASS invalid payment signature cannot mark an order paid
PASS signature and captured-payment verification
PASS signed webhook validates captured payment idempotently
